rules:
Score a policy on the frozen val set and the dev gate; append the rung to ratchet.json.

usage: ratchet.py score TAG                     print val + dev scores of results/{val,dev}/pol_TAG.json
       ratchet.py rung TAG "what changed"       score, decide keep/reject vs the incumbent, log to ratchet.json

skill = sum_e (J_fixed - J_policy)/J_fixed / sum_e (J_fixed - J_oracle)/J_fixed   (0 = fixed thermostat, 1 = perfect foresight)
J = control-dependent bill (energy + demand + gas) + lambda x degree-hours outside the occupant band.
Keep: val skill > incumbent + 0.01 AND dev gate: dev skill > 0, dev skill >= incumbent dev skill - 0.03, and
mean degree-hours per dev episode <= fixed + 1 K h.

rungs.change: R1: behaviour cloning of the perfect-foresight DP teacher (173 episodes, 127k hours), MLP 298-256-256-36, no shield
rungs.why: val skill 0.084 vs incumbent 0.000 (margin 0.01); dev skill -3.022 (incumbent 0.000), dev DH 5.0 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> REJECTED (dev gate failed)

rungs.change: R2: R1 weights + anticipatory comfort shield (stay within 1 K/h of every band edge in the next 4 h)
rungs.why: val skill 0.377 vs incumbent 0.000 (margin 0.01); dev skill -0.810 (incumbent 0.000), dev DH 1.5 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> REJECTED (dev gate failed)

rungs.change: R3: R1 weights + 6 h comfort shield (heating 1 K/h, cooling 0.5 K/h recovery allowance)
rungs.why: val skill 0.419 vs incumbent 0.000 (margin 0.01); dev skill -0.191 (incumbent 0.000), dev DH 0.6 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> REJECTED (dev gate failed)

rungs.change: R4: retrain on BC bank + DAgger round 1 (286 episodes, 210k hours; student = R1 + shield, beta 0.3), shield 4
rungs.why: val skill 0.517 vs incumbent 0.000 (margin 0.01); dev skill 0.043 (incumbent 0.000), dev DH 0.3 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> KEPT

rungs.change: R5: retrain on BC + DAgger rounds 1-2 (411 episodes; round 2 student = R4, beta 0.2), shield 4
rungs.why: val skill 0.499 vs incumbent 0.517 (margin 0.01); dev skill -0.068 (incumbent 0.043), dev DH 0.5 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> REJECTED (dev gate failed)

rungs.change: R6: wider network 298-384-384-36 (275k params), 24 epochs, same 440 episodes, shield 4
rungs.why: val skill 0.550 vs incumbent 0.517 (margin 0.01); dev skill 0.200 (incumbent 0.043), dev DH 0.4 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> KEPT

rungs.change: R7: R6 architecture + DAgger round 3 (533 episodes; round 3 student = R6, beta 0.1), shield 4
rungs.why: val skill 0.562 vs incumbent 0.550 (margin 0.01); dev skill 0.360 (incumbent 0.200), dev DH 0.3 vs fixed 0.1 K h -> KEPT
